# Tine Houmann

Tine Houmann is a senior consultant physician (overlæge) at the Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Center Glostrup, part of Region Hovedstaden's psychiatric services in Denmark [^src1][^src2]. She appears in the corpus as a named member of the steering group (styregruppe) for the Danish ADHD database, a national health quality registry that monitors the diagnosis and treatment of ADHD in children and adolescents under 18 years old [^src1][^src2].

Her role in the steering group is specifically as the representative for Region Hovedstaden (RH) [^src1]. In the later document, her affiliation is further specified as representing the Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Selskab i Danmark (the Danish Society of Child and Adolescent Psychiatry) on behalf of RH [^src2]. This places her among a broader group of steering committee members — overlæger, speciallæger, psykologer, sygeplejersker, epidemiologer, and patient-relative representatives — drawn from across Denmark's five regions, professional societies, patient organizations, and the Danish Institute for Quality and Accreditation in Healthcare (Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut), who together oversee the database's monitoring of ADHD assessment and treatment quality [^src1][^src2].

The two mentions of Houmann, from the 2023 and 2024 editions of the ADHD database annual report, are consistent with each other and describe a continuing role rather than a one-off appearance: both identify her by the same title and workplace, with the later document adding her society affiliation [^src1][^src2]. No further biographical detail, dates of appointment, or additional activities are provided in the available data.
